clinician.trajectory_summary: A 77-year-old male presented with severe back pain after a fall. Initial CT thoracolumbar spine demonstrated T7 fractures and incidentally revealed an exophytic right renal mass. A dedicated contrast abdominal CT characterized this mass as a 3.8 cm Bosniak III lesion in the right mid pole of the kidney. Subsequent biopsy of this renal lesion confirmed clear cell renal cell carcinoma. There is no conclusive evidence available to confirm the vertebral fractures as metastatic lesions from the renal carcinoma versus traumatic fractures.
